name: DroneHacks 2026 first competition run, side gap first
description: The same checkpoint lines as dronehacks_2026.json, but the last checkpoint prefers the side gap into the landing area (the line called 'Gate B') to the window. Use this for the first run, to bank a safe finish. dronehacks_2026.json, which prefers the window, is for later runs.
source: From the organizers' website (Dannie_Computer_Setup/Website_context.txt): five checkpoints, cleared in order, the fourth through Gate B or the window. The order of preference is the team's decision of 2026-11-07.
cruise_height_source: Our own choice, agreed by the team on 2026-11-07. The same as in dronehacks_2026.json.

checkpoints.name: Chicane
checkpoints.why_this_order: The side gap is open down to the floor, so the bottom laser never passes over a wall edge there, and PX4's height estimate isn't put at risk (docs/ARCHITECTURE.md, section 7). Finishing is worth 35 points and the window only 5 more, so the first run takes the side gap. The window is only used if the side gap has no route.
